warmup: pnpm exec supabase start && pnpm exec supabase stop

supabase.cmd: pnpm exec supabase start && exec docker logs -f --since 1s supabase_db_app

web.cmd: timeout 600 sh -c 'until pnpm exec supabase status >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done' && eval "$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env | grep -E '^[A-Z_]+=')" && SUPABASE_URL="$API_URL" SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$ANON_KEY}" exec pnpm dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000}
